response.reason: The kernel replaces each row of W with a ~4-bit symmetric quantization (step = rowmax/7), giving per-element quantization noise of std ≈ scale/√12 ≈ 0.12. The workload deliberately constructs x with a unit-norm component along the exact sum of these quantization residuals (residual=1.0), so the error in y coherently accumulates: per-row error ≈ ||qe_i||²/||Σqe|| ≈ 0.33, total error norm ≈ 2, while the reference output norm (driven mainly by the 0.75·direction component ≈ 2.1 per row) is ≈ 14. This yields E ≈ 0.14 > 0.12, violating the budget.
